A single, lightweight helper class allows you to add engaging, full width background images to sections of your page.

The universe is almost 14 billion years old, and, wow! Life had no problem starting here on Earth! I think it would be inexcusably egocentric of us to suggest that we're alone in the universe.

Engaging Background Images

The background images used in this template are sourced from Unsplash and are open source and free to use.

I can't tell you how many people say they were turned off from science because of a science teacher that completely sucked out all the inspiration and enthusiasm they had for the course.

content.text:
I fixed the site. Both visual tests, desktop and phone, now match the approved baselines, so I didn't approve or change any baselines.

Two values in `site/css/styles.css` had drifted from the Bootstrap defaults:
